correctness.rationale: The formula is mathematically correct. At a minimum-enclosing-ball center in a constant-curvature model space, positive support weights satisfy \(\sum_i\lambda_i u_i=0\). The exact model-space cosine law gives \(\Phi_\kappa(d_{ij})=\Psi_\kappa(R)(1-\langle u_i,u_j\rangle)\); summing with \(\lambda_i\lambda_j\) yields the exact radius identity. Padding the weights to \(n+1\) entries and expanding \(\sum_i\lambda_i^2\) gives the stated deficit decomposition. Its nonnegative terms imply the support-cardinality hierarchy, full-support threshold, weight balance and edge-shortfall bounds; lower-dimensional regular simplices attain the thresholds. The spherical diameter restriction keeps the construction in the non-antipodal Jung regime.
